# Iron Tuna

> Iron Tuna reads the **betting market** first. Your fantasy league, the daily-fantasy salary and the sportsbook each put a number on the same NFL player; Iron Tuna reads the market first, the consensus projections second, and your league's scoring on top of both, then prints where the three disagree. In season that is three lanes — Fantasy, DFS, and Wagers & prediction markets — under one hub. Before the season the same engine prices every player for your draft, in snake ranks or auction dollars.

## The idea (this is the whole thing)
A sportsbook posts a number with its own money behind it and corrects it in public within minutes of news. A ranking carries no such penalty and moves when a ranker gets round to it. When a priced market and an unpriced list disagree, **the disagreement is the thing worth reading** — so Iron Tuna prints both numbers and the gap between them rather than blending them away.

Three inputs, in order:
- **The market** — game totals, spreads and player props, pulled on a schedule and cached.
- **The consensus** — expert projections, blended toward the market where a book prices the player and left alone where none does.
- **Your league** — scoring, roster slots and FAAB budget, saved once in the browser. Every board restates its numbers in your points.

## In-season hub — https://irontuna.com/in-season
This week's reading from each lane, the three lanes themselves, and the one place to save your league. Free, no signup; the league record lives in the reader's own browser and is never uploaded.

### Fantasy — https://irontuna.com/fantasy
- This week's board with Iron Tuna, the consensus and the betting market side by side, and a Market Delta column saying which way they disagree.
- Rankings across four horizons (this week, next three, rest of season, fantasy playoffs), start/sit, and a Trade Finder that scores each side on its own horizon.
- The FAAB Advisor prices a waiver claim in the reader's own league dollars: the going rate computed one rival at a time from their remaining budget and their actual hole, what the player is worth to that roster, and what to bid.

### DFS — https://irontuna.com/dfs
- DraftKings and FanDuel salaries read against market-implied points. VVS (Vegas Value Score) is market-implied points per $1,000 of salary, indexed to the slate's median: 100 is an ordinary price, 130 is a bargain.
- A lineup builder, game stacks and the anytime-touchdown board. It builds lineups to look at and copy; nothing on the page can enter a contest.
- A pick'em board for Underdog, PrizePicks and Sleeper, showing where the model leans off a posted stat line.

### Wagers & prediction markets — https://irontuna.com/wagers
- Every game with its spread, total and implied team points, beside Iron Tuna's own model total and the gap between them. Under 2 points the two agree.
- Player props and the anytime-touchdown board, each row labelled **quoted** where a book has posted a price and **derived** where the number comes from the game line instead.
- An opinion column, labelled Opinion and kept on a public record.
- Prediction-market contract prices beside the model's own probability: not live yet, and the page says so.
- **21+. Informational only. Iron Tuna is not a sportsbook or exchange, places no bets and holds no funds. Availability varies by state. No affiliate links and no sportsbook sign-up offers anywhere on the site.** Problem gambling: call or text 1-800-GAMBLER.

## Draft season — https://irontuna.com/auctiondraft
The same engine, aimed at draft night. Auction is the format it is built for; snake is fully supported.
- **Three numbers on every player** in an auction: *Proj* (the going rate the room is likely to pay, on the price curve your budget actually produces), *Value* (his projected points converted to dollars against a replacement-level starter), and *You* (what one more dollar buys your lineup, given what you have already won and the money left).
- A budget-aware planner that solves, exactly, the highest-scoring starting lineup your budget can buy; a live Auction Manager that re-prices the board as money leaves the room.
- Snake: custom rankings for your scoring, ADP, tier-cliff alerts, and survival odds — the chance each player lasts to your next pick.
- An AI Value Coach that answers "do I go to $41 here?" against the roster you have actually bought.
- Supports salary-cap, keeper, Superflex and 2-QB formats and any custom scoring.

## Key facts
- **Iron Tuna is provided for social and entertainment purposes only.** Every number on it is an estimate or a snapshot of a market that moves; none of it is advice, and anything a reader intends to act on should be verified at its own source first.
- The whole in-season section is free and needs no account. Saving a league writes to that browser's local storage and nothing else.
- Draft season: free values with no signup; a one-time **$9.99** unlocks your league's exact custom scoring, board reordering, the live draft-day tools and the Value Coach.
- Nothing is fetched from a sportsbook by the reader's browser. Lines are a market median pulled on a schedule into the site's own cache, and every surface says how fresh it is.
- The week is read from the NFL schedule, never from the calendar: a week is current until its own last game has finished. If the schedule feed does not answer, every surface says so rather than guessing — a wrong week silently mislabels every number under it.
- Where a board has no data it says so explicitly. It is blank rather than stale.
- Game lines and player data via nflverse (CC BY 4.0).

## FAQ
- Is it free? The whole in-season section is, with no signup. On the draft side the board with expert default values is free; a one-time $9.99 unlocks custom scoring and the live tools.
- Do I need an account? No, and there is no password sharing. The in-season league record lives in your browser. Draft purchasers can restore access on another device with a one-tap email magic link.
- Does Iron Tuna take bets? No. It is not a sportsbook or an exchange, it places no bets, it holds no funds, and it carries no affiliate links or sportsbook sign-up offers. Odds are shown for reading, 21+.
- What is a "Market Delta"? The gap between the market's number for a player and the consensus projection, in points and in ranking slots. It is printed rather than hidden.
- What is VVS? Market-implied points per $1,000 of DFS salary, indexed to the slate median. 100 is ordinary, 130 is a bargain.
- Does it work for any league? Yes — PPR, half-PPR and standard in season; salary-cap, keeper, Superflex, 2-QB and any custom scoring on the draft side.
